exclude.bureau_recovery_flag: leakage: recovery happens after charge-off (AUC 0.906; 100% default when 1)
exclude.grade: old model output; used as benchmark
exclude.sub_grade: old model output; used as benchmark
exclude.int_rate: old model output (price set from sub_grade); tested in Part B ablation
exclude.issue_dt: used for the time split only
exclude.title: redundant with purpose (63% identical, A1)
exclude.zip_code: 3-digit location: high cardinality and a proxy risk for protected groups
exclude.annual_inc_corrected: audit flag: marks planted errors, absent from holdout
exclude.bc_util_corrected: audit flag: marks planted errors, absent from holdout
exclude.revol_util_corrected: audit flag: marks planted errors, absent from holdout
exclude.loan_amnt_corrected: audit flag: marks planted errors, absent from holdout
exclude.fico_swapped: audit flag: marks planted errors, absent from holdout
exclude.earliest_cr_invalid: audit flag: marks planted errors, absent from holdout
exclude.installment_mismatch: audit flag: marks planted errors, absent from holdout
exclude.zip_state_mismatch: audit flag: marks planted errors, absent from holdout
exclude.installment: encodes int_rate given amount and term (old-model pricing); Part B ablation group
exclude.installment_to_income: built on installment, so carries int_rate; Part B ablation group
exclude.principal_per_year_to_income: tested: weaker than loan_to_income (AUC 0.532 vs 0.591), spearman 0.897 with it; dividing by term opposes the term effect
exclude.application_type: constant in the fit sample (Individual only); joint applications appear from 2015 and in the holdout: unseen by the model, route to review / monitor
exclude.purpose: replaced by purpose_grp (levels < 100 loans in fit merged into 'other')
exclude.emp_title: replaced by job_family (keyword rules, first match wins; 65.5% matched)
exclude.verification_status: replaced by verification_grp: Verified and Source Verified merged (WoE -0.138 vs -0.118; IV 0.0458 -> 0.0457)
exclude.emp_length_years: no predictive value on new data: 2015 AUC 0.5076 with 2013-14 WoE (rule: < 0.53 -> exclude); IV 0.012

notes: purpose: 3 risk levels for the scorecard. Inside-level chi-square p = 0.855 / 0.942, between p = 4e-10; 2015 AUC with 2013-14 WoE 0.5415 vs 0.5443 for 8 groups (difference < 0.005, within noise). Monitor medical (20.0% -> 29.5%, n~150/yr).
home_ownership: kept as 3 levels (RENT WoE -0.170, OWN 0.011, MORTGAGE 0.139; all groups >= 1,406 loans; no new levels in 2015)

fairness_review.job_family: weak but real signal (2015 AUC 0.5438, IV 0.014); possible proxy for protected traits. Keep only if it adds >= 0.005 validation AUC to the full model (Part B ablation); excluded from the scorecard by default.

unseen_category_rule: any category level not seen in the fit sample gets WoE 0 (neutral) in the scorecard
